# Leave Policy

All staff accrue paid leave on a monthly basis. Leave must be requested through
the HR portal at least two weeks in advance where practical.

## Accrual Rates

| Band | Annual Days | Carryover |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Junior | 20 | 5 |
| Senior | 25 | 10 |

## Sick Leave

Sick leave is separate from annual leave and does not carry over.
